item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.1
item.description:
usefulwaves 0.0.1 for Apple silicon Macs.
- Dictate into the app you are using with on-device speech recognition. - Rewrite selected text and save notes with Quick Actions. - Capture meetings and QA reviews in your workspace.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.2
item.description:
usefulwaves 0.0.2 for Apple silicon Macs.
- Read the meeting summary and prepared tasks on one page. Open Transcript for the timestamped conversation. - Copy a task or QA finding with its evidence, check it off, or open it in Captures to keep working. - Select related tasks or findings and send them to one workflow session.
This update also improves dictation startup and the first paste. Quick Actions now support questions and translations.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.3
item.description:
usefulwaves 0.0.3 for Apple silicon Macs.
- Generate a meeting summary and tasks even when a transcript link is missing. Read the timestamped conversation in a larger window. - Follow progress during long recaps. If preparation stops, retry to resume from the last completed batch. - Dictation and Quick Actions better preserve your wording and regional spelling. Buttons and editable fields are easier to recognize.
This release also improves recovery after microphone disconnections and interrupted QA recordings.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.4
item.description: - Preview meeting tasks and QA findings before saving them to Captures. Open Sources for timestamps, transcript excerpts, and screenshot text. - Read transcripts in a larger window at the original text size. Secondary buttons now look consistent across Home, Settings, and setup. - Hold the stop shortcut to send Return after dictation. After pasting, usefulwaves checks that it can confirm the intended input.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.5
item.description: Recording now stops when you release the shortcut, even while usefulwaves checks selected text. Notes retain edits and checklist items through Undo and recovery. Large capture libraries stay responsive during saves. This release also improves recording Trash, capture search, and desktop handoffs.

item.title: usefulwaves 0.0.6
item.description: Settings tabs now align with the page heading and adapt when you resize the sidebar. Open Diagnostics from Account to view local logs. Press Done or Escape to return to Account.
